}}{{TIDTOC|adapter}} ==Overview== "01-01007004-00 R0B" is silkscreened on the board in the FCC photos.
The schematics refer the the MAC/BB and RF chip as Ardon2 (82532MDE?) and Ramon2 (appears to be 82532RGE), respectively.
This device does not appear to have been sold / released.
